True resilience means asking not just when demand spikes, but whose lives are at stake and why their neighborhoods aren’t getting upgraded first. Until allocation algorithms are legally bound to prioritize vulnerability over profitability, “data-driven” just means “exclusion-optimized.” And let’s be real: if the grid can shift power for corporate offices during lunch hour, it can damn well protect kids and seniors during heatwaves—someone just has to decide it matters more than shareholder returns.
